scope: Full-data grouped text-baseline CV and split diagnostics; not transformer CV

cross_validation.model: train-only TF-IDF + Ridge; not transformer cross-validation
cross_validation.dispersion_interpretation: Descriptive fold SD; not a confidence interval

split_analysis.protocol_selection: Predeclared category stratification; no seed/score search

public_data_policy: Aggregate diagnostics and checksums only; row IDs, text and prediction rows excluded
